axes.name: ImmuneActivationScore
axes.placeholder_note: This axis is a label leak from the JHMC dataset (see ADR 0001 + MODEL_CARD.md). The device cannot produce this value. We feed the combined-class mean (Normal + Activation) so the model is biased toward 'uncertain'. Predictions from v1 are not reliable. Replace this whole axis in v2.

normalization_note: Confirm with EI Studio: if the impulse's DSP block applies normalization (mean/std subtract or min/max scale), set this field accordingly. Raw Data block with no DSP = no normalization needed.
